items.prompt: Please generate an image based on the theme: “A stunning woman on a crowded commuter train who makes people instinctively take a second look.” She is a 20-year-old Japanese woman with a refined beauty that naturally draws everyone’s gaze. She has soft, long black hair styled into a low ponytail. Large double-lidded eyes, a well-defined nose bridge, and subtly glossy, modest lips. Her face is small, with a long, elegant neck, and a slender yet feminine figure with gentle curves. Her outfit consists of a lightweight white shirt and a beige tight skirt. The shirt has a slight translucency with natural wrinkles. The scene takes place inside a crowded morning train. She is holding onto a strap, caught in a moment of slightly losing her balance. The shot is taken from a diagonal rear angle, from a passenger’s perspective, looking slightly upward. She appears natural and unaware of the camera. The image has a slight motion blur and rough framing.
items.title: 通勤列车女性人像
